title: Evangelions
summary: Each Evangelion has its own gun, damage and A.T. Field.

sections.title: Modified Unit Eight γ
items: Possesses pinpoint accuracy. Excels at precision strikes.
Master of light-speed projectiles and linear ballistics. Powerful sniper attacks are especially effective against large enemies.
A.T. Field values (by A.T. Field part level)
3, switched by Portable Weapon Lv 1, Portable Weapon Lv 6, Portable Weapon Lv 8; 3 levels each

sections.title: New Unit Two α
items: Possesses exceptional firepower and devastating area-of-effect bombardment capabilities. Unstoppable against any foe.
Rains a hail of machine gun bullets for battlefield dominance. Excels at close to mid-range combat.
A.T. Field values (by A.T. Field part level)
3, switched by Portable Weapon Lv 1, Portable Weapon Lv 6, Portable Weapon Lv 8; 3 levels each

sections.title: Mark.09
items: Excels in defense and close combat, though lacks focused firepower against single targets.
High resistance to all attacks. Specializes in A.T. Field defense.
A.T. Field values (by A.T. Field part level)
3, switched by Portable Weapon Lv 1, Portable Weapon Lv 6, Portable Weapon Lv 8; 3 levels each
